summary: Socket/endpoint structure initializer (this-call, returns this). First builds two temporary sockaddr_in-style blocks: the WORD family fields this+0x0 and this+0x10 set to 2 (AF_INET), the IP dwords this+0x4 and this+0x14 set to htonl(0) (INADDR_ANY), and the port WORDs this+0x2 and this+0x12 set to htons(0). It then resets a ring-buffer region at word offset 27 (byte 54) via RingBufferHeadTailReset, after which every field from this+0x0 through this+0x34 is zeroed, except this+0x20 which is set to -1 (all bits set). Returns this. Uses the imported htonl/htons socket-helper functions via their import pointer globals.

operations.description: Set the WORD address-family field this+0x0 to 2 (AF_INET).
Call htonl(0) through the imported helper and store the result into the IP field this+0x4.
Call htons(0) through the imported helper and store the result into the port WORD this+0x2.
Set the WORD address-family field this+0x10 of the second block to 2 (AF_INET).
Call htonl(0) through the imported helper and store the result into the IP field this+0x14 of the second block.
Call htons(0) through the imported helper and store the result into the port WORD this+0x12 of the second block.
Reset the ring-buffer region starting at word offset 27 (byte offset 54) with RingBufferHeadTailReset.
Zero the dword run this+0x0, this+0x4, this+0x8, this+0xC, this+0x10, this+0x14, this+0x18, wiping the temporary sockaddr_in blocks.
Set this+0x1C to 0, this+0x20 to -1 (all bits set), this+0x24 to 0, the byte this+0x28 to 0, this+0x2C to 0, this+0x30 to 0, and the WORD this+0x34 to 0.
